name: Fantasy: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Fantasy look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, epic fantasy concept painting, painterly brushwork, ornate hand-crafted armour and cloth, ancient architecture with real scale, golden light through mist, rich jewel-tone palette, volumetric god rays, atmospheric depth
negative_prompt: modern clothing, guns, cars, sci-fi technology, photographic snapshot look, text, watermark
